title: 第5章 领证赤鸦炼日诀第18章 弟弟恢复五行失衡
content_zh:
将修士证收入道土。
白玉牌样式的修士证，漂浮在道土中央，与道土气息交融，背面金红色的帝国龙徽熠熠生辉。
隐约间，陆羽听见声微弱的龙吟在灵魂深处响起。
他这块小小的道土似乎是与一位高贵的庞然大物产生了一缕细微的联系。
“你也感受到了！那是帝国的国运所化的气运之龙，领了证后，你便算是彻底成为帝国的一份子！受到帝国国运庇护，可以免受一些阴邪咒法的侵害，同时你的所作所为，也要践行帝国的道德与正义，与帝国走在同一条道路之上！”
陆羽领证后感受到的东西，罗悦也经历过了一遍，她将这一切解释给陆羽听。
“原来如此！”
陆羽听后，略微一想，便大概明白了罗悦的意思。
帝国国运之龙，这等高大上的存在，现在的陆羽还接触不到这么高的层次，难以理解其存在。
但领证之后，陆羽能感受到一股暖暖的力量萦绕在他的脑海之中，默默地守护着他。
这道力量，想来就是帝国国运给他带来的庇护。
至于如何获得更多的好处，那就要陆羽实事求是，走在帝国的道路上，践行正义，守护法律。
这是一个正常的帝国公民，都应该做的事，陆羽如今成了帝国的地仙修士，自然责无旁贷。
领完修士证之后，罗悦把电脑屏幕掰向陆羽，让他看见屏幕上的文字。
“接下来，你可以从我这选取一门功法和一门法术，你看看屏幕上的这些，有什么不懂的都可以问我！”
陆羽朝电脑屏幕上望去，功法种类不多，只有五门基础功法，分属五行。
《赤鸦炼日诀》、《玄龟镇水功》、《苍木灵蛇法》、《厚土载元身》，《锐金破妄诀》
法术倒是多了些，有十多门可以选择。
例如：望气术，灵眼咒，摄土成甲咒，阴风六欲剑.......
“能选择的功法就这些吗？”

功法能选择的太少，陆羽瞧了瞧，忍不住问出心中的疑惑。
罗悦听完莞尔一笑：
“当然不止这些功法了，但这五门分属五行的功法，是帝国官方大修士精心挑选出来的基础功法，最适合像我们这种刚踏入仙途的萌新修士入门修炼的，难度低，入门容易！”
“你若是想要学一些难度高的功法，我这里也有，但那些高级功法入门难度就高得离谱了！你看了也会觉得跟天书一样！”
罗悦也明白陆羽的疑惑，耐心地解释道，同时也在电脑上给陆羽找出了一本高级功法《大日真解》的序章。
“这是什么呀！！”
陆羽大眼一瞧，顿时感觉头昏眼花，完全无法理解这门高深的功法。
学不会，根本不是他这个刚踏入仙途的普通修士能理解，能学会的。
被《大日真解》教育之后，陆羽收起好高骛远的心思，老老实实地询问罗悦，让她推荐功法和法术的选择。
罗悦沉思了一番，说道：
content_en:
Put the monk's certificate into the Taoist soil.
The monk's certificate in the style of a white jade card floats in the center of the Taoist soil, blending with the aura of the Taoist soil. The golden-red imperial dragon emblem on the back shines brightly.
Vaguely, Lu Yu heard a faint dragon roar resounding deep in his soul.
His small piece of Taoist soil seemed to have a subtle connection with a noble giant.
"You feel it too! It is the dragon of destiny transformed by the empire's national destiny. After receiving the certificate, you will become a member of the empire! Being protected by the empire's national destiny, you can be protected from some evil spells. At the same time, in everything you do, you must practice the empire's morality and justice, and walk on the same path as the empire!"
Luo Yue also experienced what Lu Yu felt after receiving the certificate, and she explained it all to Lu Yu.
"That's it!"
After Lu Yu heard this, he thought for a moment and roughly understood what Luo Yue meant.
The Dragon of the Empire's National Destiny was such a high-level existence. Lu Yu was not yet exposed to such a high level, and it was difficult to understand its existence.
But after receiving the certificate, Lu Yu could feel a warm power lingering in his mind, guarding him silently.
This power is probably the protection brought to him by the destiny of the empire.
As for how to obtain more benefits, Lu Yu must seek truth from facts, walk on the path of the empire, practice justice, and protect the law.
This is what a normal citizen of the empire should do. Now that Lu Yu has become an Earth Immortal monk in the empire, he naturally has no shirk in his duties.
After receiving the monk's certificate, Luo Yue opened the computer screen to Lu Yu and let him see the words on the screen.
"Next, you can choose a technique and a spell from me. Look at these on the screen. If you don't understand anything, you can ask me!"
Lu Yu looked at the computer screen. There were not many types of exercises, only five basic exercises, belonging to the five elements.
"Red Crow Sun Refining Technique", "Black Turtle Water Suppressing Technique", "Agwood Spiritual Snake Technique", "Thick Earth Carrying Yuan Shen", "Rui Jin Destroying Illusion Technique"
There are more spells, with more than ten to choose from.
For example: the qi-gazing technique, the spiritual eye spell, the earth-turning spell, the Yinfeng Six Desire Sword...
"Are these the only exercises you can choose from?"
There were too few skills to choose from. Lu Yu took a look and couldn't help but ask his doubts.
Luo Yue smiled after hearing this:
"Of course there are more than just these exercises, but these five exercises belonging to the five elements are the basic exercises carefully selected by the official imperial monks. They are most suitable for new monks like us who have just entered the path of immortality. They are low in difficulty and easy to get started!"
"If you want to learn some difficult exercises, I have them here, but those advanced exercises are ridiculously difficult to get started with! You will feel like they are like a heavenly book!"
Luo Yue also understood Lu Yu's doubts and explained patiently. At the same time, he also found the prologue of the advanced exercise "The True Solution to the Sun" on the computer for Lu Yu.
"What is this!!"
Lu Yu looked at it with wide eyes and suddenly felt dizzy and unable to understand this profound technique at all.
Not being able to learn it was simply not something that an ordinary monk like him, who had just entered the path of immortality, could understand or learn.
After being educated by "The True Jie of the Great Sun", Lu Yu put aside his lofty ideals and honestly asked Luo Yue to recommend exercises and spells.
